OperationalLocation provides the operational location of the Device or Component. The structure within the string may expose several levels. How this is exposed, which delimiters are used, etc. is vendor-specific. Examples of such strings are “Warehouse1/Sheet3” or “StainlessSteelTote3” (see OPC UA OPC 10000-110 for more details).
